description:
How many residents follow each religion, and what share of the area that is: 30 groups from Anglican to Sikh to no religion, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 11,000 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few residents for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/religion`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_population, christianity_count, christianity_pct, anglican_count, anglican_pct, baptist_count, baptist_pct, brethren_count, brethren_pct, catholic_count, catholic_pct, churches_of_christ_count, churches_of_christ_pct, eastern_orthodox_count, eastern_orthodox_pct, jehovahs_witnesses_count, jehovahs_witnesses_pct, latter_day_saints_count, latter_day_saints_pct, lutheran_count, lutheran_pct, oriental_orthodox_count, oriental_orthodox_pct, other_christian_count, other_christian_pct, other_protestant_count, other_protestant_pct, pentecostal_count, pentecostal_pct, presbyterian_reformed_count, presbyterian_reformed_pct, salvation_army_count, salvation_army_pct, seventh_day_adventist_count, seventh_day_adventist_pct, uniting_church_count, uniting_church_pct, assyrian_apostolic_count, assyrian_apostolic_pct, christian_unspecified_count, christian_unspecified_pct, buddhism_count, buddhism_pct, hinduism_count, hinduism_pct, islam_count, islam_pct, judaism_count, judaism_pct, sikhism_count, sikhism_pct, aboriginal_traditional_count, aboriginal_traditional_pct, other_religious_groups_count, other_religious_groups_pct, other_religions_count, other_religions_pct, no_religion_count, no_religion_pct, secular_beliefs_count, secular_beliefs_pct, other_spiritual_beliefs_count, other_spiritual_beliefs_pct, no_religion_or_secular_count, no_religion_or_secular_pct, not_stated_count, not_stated_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.
